CustomField.description: Date where follow up will be triggered
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Funds_Released_Date__c), ISBLANK(TRIM(Parent_Email__c)), ISBLANK(Annual_Follow_Up_Cursor__c), CASE( Status__c, "Equipment Returned", 1, "Pending", 1, "Denied", 1, "Withdrawn", 1, "Funds Expired", 1, 0 ) = 1 ), NULL, IF( AND(MONTH(Funds_Released_Date__c) = 2, DAY(Funds_Released_Date__c) = 28), ADDMONTHS( Funds_Released_Date__c - 1, 12 * MAX( 1, YEAR(Annual_Follow_Up_Cursor__c) - YEAR(Funds_Released_Date__c) + IF( DATE(YEAR(Annual_Follow_Up_Cursor__c), 2, 28) <= Annual_Follow_Up_Cursor__c, 1, 0 ) ) ) + 1, ADDMONTHS( Funds_Released_Date__c, 12 * MAX( 1, YEAR(Annual_Follow_Up_Cursor__c) - YEAR(Funds_Released_Date__c) + IF( ADDMONTHS( Funds_Released_Date__c, 12 * ( YEAR(Annual_Follow_Up_Cursor__c) - YEAR(Funds_Released_Date__c) ) ) <= Annual_Follow_Up_Cursor__c, 1, 0 ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Next Follow-Up Date
